# Clinical Practice Decision

This folder contains topics detailing the operational and systemic choices made within the Danish healthcare system to manage and monitor clinical practice, with a strong focus on atrial fibrillation care. It documents both localized institutional decisions, such as emergency reception pathways, and standardized interventions like structured patient education programs. Additionally, it covers the long-term treatment adherence metrics used to evaluate the ongoing quality of cardiovascular care across regions and hospitals.

## Pages

- [[clinical-practice-decision|Clinical Practice Decision]] — Explores institutional choices for emergency pathways and systemic quality indicators measuring long-term anticoagulation adherence for atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[struktureret-undervisningsprogram|Struktureret undervisningsprogram]] — Details the structured education program intervention for newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients and its tracking via national quality standards.
